note: Re-judged 2026-11-23 by an independent agent after rfc4301_outbound_steps_linux_test.go changed (reconcileForTest helper in outStepSPD). RFC 4301 Section 5.1 step 2: "Match the packet headers against the cache for the SPD specified by the SPD-ID from step 1." Linux keeps no SPD flow cache, so every outbound packet is matched directly against the SPD Ze installs via createFirstChildSA, reconcileSPDPolicies and installUnmatched. TestRFC4301OutboundPacketTakesTheDispositionOfTheEntryItMatches confirms datagrams from one source differing in destination and port hit Child SA PROTECT (ESP with child.OutboundSPI, XfrmOutNoStates unchanged) and operator BYPASS (delivered clear, no ESP). TestRFC4301OutboundPacketIsDiscardedByTheEntryItMatches confirms header-level port discrimination (10.3.0.5:7009 misses the port-7001 BYPASS and hits the catch-all: EPERM, XfrmOutPolBlock +1, not delivered). Supplementary boundary units in rfc4301_boundary_linux_test.go pin exact outbound direction/prefixes/port 443 and refuse out-of-mask ports. Verdict stands.
